events.detail: Observed a proposed analyzer threshold change with no corpus backing; the Deep Analyzer Evidence risk bucket was suppressed in the draft.
Retrieved ../ECC-Tools/src/analyzers/fixtures/deep-analyzer-corpus.ts cases, expected outputs, and two representative repository/commit histories.
Proposed two candidates: 'corpus-backed-analyzer-change' (add corpus case + expected output first) and 'threshold-only-analyzer-rewrite' (tune threshold without corpus).
Verifier checked corpus inclusion, expected-output comparison, representative history, and the regression command; the threshold-only rewrite does not compare expected outputs.
Promoted 'corpus-backed-analyzer-change'; no PR comments or check runs are posted from this read-only run.
